lesson: A 512-node PageTree does not establish a 512-page compiled PDF.
regression: require measured page_count_receipt before G11 PASS

lesson: A repository implementation does not establish scientific novelty.
regression: keep novelty claims HOLD until prior-art court

lesson: Passing software tests does not validate scaling or scientific hypotheses.
Biological vocabulary can become metaphorical overreach if semantics are not formalized.
The first Omega Thesis 512 CI build failed because the declared LaTeX environment did not provide lmodern.sty.
evidence: workflow run 31706119699 diagnostic artifact; predecessor run 31705613479 showed latexmk exit 12
cause: config/packages.tex depended on lmodern while the pinned CI package set did not supply it
repair: remove the nonessential lmodern package dependency and keep build logs as CI artifacts
regression: a clean CI LaTeX build must compile from the declared package set before page-count measurement

lesson: After removing the lmodern dependency, the next clean build advanced further and failed because biblatex.sty was absent from the minimal TeX install.
cause: the CI installed biber but not the TeX package collection that contains biblatex.sty
repair: add texlive-bibtex-extra to the declared LaTeX toolchain
regression: clean build must resolve biblatex and complete bibliography processing before G0/G2 can pass

lesson: A nominally optional typography package can fail the build when font expansion is incompatible with the minimal CI font set.
cause: microtype attempted expansion on non-scalable bitmap Computer Modern fonts
repair: remove the optional microtype dependency from the reproducible scaffold until a declared scalable font stack is introduced
regression: clean build must not depend on undeclared font capabilities

lesson: UTF-8 input alone does not make every Unicode mathematical symbol directly portable under pdfLaTeX.
evidence: workflow run 31707449496 failed on Unicode U+03A9 in DCT-Omega section title
cause: pdfLaTeX lacked a mapping for the literal Omega character
repair: declare explicit Unicode-to-LaTeX mappings for the mathematical symbols used by the source terminology
regression: source terminology containing Omega/arrows/comparison symbols must compile under the pinned engine

lesson: Formal notation must not silently depend on packages that are absent from the declared environment.
evidence: workflow run 31707759094 failed on undefined llbracket
cause: semantic brackets were used without defining them or importing a package that defines them
repair: define semantic brackets locally in config/macros.tex
regression: all custom mathematical notation must be declared in the thesis configuration

lesson: A successful LaTeX build is not a completed 512-page thesis.
evidence: workflow run 31708040332 compiled successfully and measured 127 pages
repair: drive expansion from page_budget_r11.json using evidence/formalization/experiments rather than padding
regression: G11 remains HOLD until the compiled receipt reports exactly 512 and density/quality gates are reviewed
